_doc: tools/ground_release.py — the near-road ground released to 3DEP inside the declared zones (ledger 0046 v0.18.0 integration fix round). h = local y (3DEP - origin elev) at lattice nodes (I*cell, J*cell); zones resolved on data/centerline.local.json (sides: +1 left of travel, -1 right)

zones.name: alvarado_creek_bank
zones.why: criterion 4 sections 2150/2200/2250 (creek bank 2.2-9.6 m from the pavement) and 2400 (a 2 m rise 9.7 m from it)

zones.name: college_south_approach
zones.why: criterion 4 section 2000: the ground under College Ave's south approach 6.2 m under the road where 3DEP has the embankment at road height

zones.name: lmb_alvarado_creek
zones.why: criterion 4 section 4050: solid fill under Lake Murray Blvd where 3DEP has Alvarado Creek 8 m under the deck

zones.name: college_i8_span
zones.why: the view lens (v0.18.0 integration fix round 2): under College Ave's deck the I-8's north carriageway climbed a 5-6 m hump to within 2 m of the deck, on ground the draft had seated at deck height; fresh 3DEP 1 m along the centreline: the deck leaves its south embankment at s ~2580 (7.8 -> 3.1 m local) and meets its north one at s ~2670 (4.1 -> 11.8 m), bare earth 2.1-3.5 m between them

zones.name: lmb_i8_span
zones.why: the view lens (v0.18.0 integration fix round 2): the I-8's outer lanes climbed Lake Murray Blvd's abutment slopes to 21-23.7 m against a 24.1 m deck; fresh 3DEP 1 m along the centreline: the deck leaves its south embankment at s ~13338 (25.5 -> 20.5 m local) and meets the island between the freeway and Alvarado Creek at s ~13407 (19.2 -> 23.9 m), bare earth 18.7-19.3 m between them

zones.name: alvarado_college_terrace
zones.why: the view lens (v0.18.0 integration fix round 2): a 3-4 m pleated grass curtain beside Alvarado under College Ave's bridge, where the college_south_approach zone's real terrace met Alvarado's held road-height verge 1.25 m away; fresh 3DEP across s 2030: the real ground climbs from the kerb (0.4 m local at lat -8) to a terrace at 3.2-3.6 m by lat -10 and on up to College's approach, which the build held at road height out to lat -16

zones.name: college_approach_foot
zones.why: the same curtain's other end: College Ave's south approach, where it runs beside Alvarado 5-6 m over it; a bank zone (beside the road only: 3DEP has the road on the ground here, 0.5 m under it at s 2545, so a span would open air under it). Fix round 4 (the view lens: a stepped curtain of vertical slivers seen from Alvarado, worst at this zone's old start, s 2500): from s 2410, where the embankment edge first falls over 1 m (1.0 m at s 2410, 3.4 m by s 2470, 4.9 m at s 2500 in v0.17.1 and since, unguarded); the ground under College's sidewalk is held under it, and between the two sidewalks (2-3 m apart, too close for both batters) the ground is the straight bank between their edges

zones.name: college_north_approach
zones.why: fix round 4 (the view lens: short grass fins 20-50 m west of College Ave's north approach, s 2660-2700, seen over the parapet from the seat; worse than v0.17.1): college_i8_span ended at s 2690 and ramped back over 4 m to the near-road verge the build holds, which fresh 3DEP reads 1.3-3.3 m above the real earth 20-35 m out at s 2680-2720; the 1.25 m lattice sampled that 4 m ramp as a row of teeth. Beside the road only (the approach sits on its embankment, on the ground), from the span's north end (no ramp there: the zones abut) to s 2745

zones.name: college_split_cut
zones.why: Ledger 0055 (Kevin, seat, 2026-10-14: 'cut into the hillside the way California does and has like a flat side of the hill alongside one side of the road'). College Ave north of Del Cerro is a split-level divided road: on fresh 3DEP 1 m the northbound carriageway rides a bench 2.4-5.7 m over the southbound one (v1216-1414) and the hill east of it rises another 4-8 m within 20 m (to 168-171 m against a road at ~157 m). The build carries both carriageways at the southbound grade (one slab, ledger 0037; the L3 note in 0055: the northbound lanes run up to ~5.7 m under their real bench, by Kevin's choice). East of the slab (right of the street layout's northbound travel) the ground is the real earth cut back by a planar earth batter (ground_release_blend BATTER_CUT, 1 m per metre) from the east pavement edge, read out to cut_reach_m 20 m (= terrain.clamp_corridor_m, the construction zone: at v1279-1306 the hill stands 12-13.8 m over the deck 12-14 m out, beyond the default 12 m reach), its top rounded into the real hill over round_m 3 m (docs/ROAD-CONSTRUCTION.md: 2-5 m). Past the daylight line it is untouched 3DEP; the west side (house lots at grade) has no zone. rails false: the ground rises from the kerb (a cut), so the release makes no drop to guard; the only fall a station reads there is the sidewalk's own outer apron, as on every street of the loop (the first rehearsal stood a jersey rail along all 816 m). Declared by centreline vertex, v1197.6-1468.5 (round 2: a station slides when the road before it changes length; the split level fades out north of v1400, the hillside cut runs on to ~v1470). Round 2 (the truth lens): with College registered onto its measured carriageways (route.median_registration) the cut's toe stands at the real northbound east kerb (~22-25 m east of the raw line); the face is ~10-11 m tall where the real one is ~5 m, because the deck keeps the southbound grade ~5-5.9 m under the real northbound bench (Kevin's choice)
